## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous text preserves a brief Pure Land *zhòu* (spell / dhāraṇī) attributed to Amitābha Buddha. The text functions as a Pure Land devotional spell, parallel to *[Bá yī qiè yè zhàng T0368](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0094)*.

**Abstract**

The text is anonymous and undated; conventional scholarship places it broadly in the medieval Tang-Sòng period of Pure Land devotional literature.

The Taishō text (T0369) is established on the standard apparatus.
